name: Meta.aia Official World Pack
author: Meta + Claude · @meta.aia · Desk 3690
blurb: Name your desk. Meta + Claude draft. You decide. The card is the UI. Works on automateitaway.com/desk that already exists. Collect stays HOLD.
tagline: Name your desk. Meta AIs draft. You decide. The card is the UI.

face.how: Meta and Claude draft on the card. You tap Yes, Stop, or Kill. Collect stays HOLD. Nothing sends itself.

help: Open an existing desk at automateitaway.com/desk — same AIA account owns desks and can sit on others.
Install Meta.aia with Yes. Give is the file. Update is install again. Nothing silent.
Connect a Meta worker webhook (POST /aia/card.created) on Pipes. Worker drafts only — never Yes, Stop, pay, or send.
Drop work → card appears → Meta + Claude draft side-by-side → DRAFT READY → you pick → Copy / Text / Email / Hand.
Setup cards 1–9 each need Yes. Wallet is MetaMask / WalletConnect — AIA does not hold keys. Not Wallet.AIA.
Usage fees HOLD until Yes + a real money pipe. No on-chain claim. Full history through the AIA account.
collect: invoice / pay stays HOLD until Yes + a real money pipe
rails: Desk AIs draft. Humans decide. No AI sends, pays, or binds without human Yes.
AIA never sends — only DRAFTS. Yes / Stop / Kill are human actions. Always.
Give is the file. Update is install again. Recurring update HOLD. Nothing silent.
One AIA account owns desks and can sit on others. Full history accounted.
Wallet MetaMask / WalletConnect. Not Wallet.AIA. AIA does not hold keys.
Worker verifies webhook signature when a secret is set. No spoof.
Collect and usage fees HOLD until Yes + a real money pipe. No on-chain claim.
One nudge, then stop. Physical / money / send actions wait on Yes.
